title: Using a Fact Family to Solve

steps.body: A fact family uses the same two parts and whole. The picture links 8 + 5 = 13 with 13 − 5 = 8.
steps.narration: A fact family uses the same two parts and whole. The picture links 8 + 5 = 13 with 13 − 5 = 8.

widget.prompt: Use the family 5, 7, 12 on 5 + __ = 12: start at 12 and count back 5. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 12 and count back 5: you land on 7.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 7 — the family fact 12 − 5 = 7 solved the unknown in one step.

predict.prompt: 5 + __ = 12 and 12 − 5 = __ come from the same family. Do they share an answer?
predict.reveal: Both facts rearrange the same three family numbers, so the hidden value is one and the same.

concept.body: The number bond and equations use the same three numbers. An addition fact can help solve its matching subtraction fact.
concept.narration: The number bond and equations use the same three numbers. An addition fact can help solve its matching subtraction fact.

explanationVariants: Name the family's three numbers first.
The subtraction member reveals the missing part.

widget.prompt: Use the matching addition fact: Fact family 4, 7, 11; 11 − 4 = ?

commonErrors.feedback: Four is the part being removed. The other family part is the answer.
Adding eleven and four leaves the fact family instead of finding the missing part.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Think: four plus what makes eleven?
